display.purpose: The owner's name in Reading mode, in Fraunces, one word per line.

headline.purpose: Section titles in Fraunces; sticky in the left four columns from lg in Reading mode, top of the column in the map panel.

title.purpose: Project and paper titles in Geist.

lead.purpose: Hero role line and the About opening statement.

label.purpose: Mono labels, coordinates, counts, region-label buttons, the map hint and the machine line.

display-map.purpose: The same h1 over the sky as the Star map overview title block (clamp 2.75rem to 6rem).

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: The just-earned stamp presses down; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: The hairline above each section draws in from the left; no-preference and @supports only.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: Underline sweep on hover and focus; none under reduce.

motion.name: sky-tiers
motion.value: full | lite (half stars, 30fps, no comet) | still (camera cuts, paints on demand)
motion.purpose: Chosen from the median drawing work of the first 60 drawn frames (over 8ms steps down); reduced motion starts still; stops in a hidden tab.

motion.name: camera-flight
motion.value: 650ms ease-in-out (cubic), zoom interpolated geometrically; drag coast decays over ~220ms, capped at 2.5 px/ms
motion.purpose: Map camera flies to a region or back to the overview; cut instantly in the still tier (reduced motion).

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: The section panel slides in from the right.

breakpoints.name: panel-wide
breakpoints.value: 1024px (lg): 720px drawer; below it a full-width sheet

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Secondary action: hairline pill whose border turns to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-edge); color: var(--color-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Top-bar pill that goes to the other mode: Star map or Reading mode.

components.css: .ds-region { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-void) 80%, transparent); color: var(--color-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-region:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Map Panel Back Bar
components.description: Sticky top of the section panel: hairline below, underlined back button.
components.css: .ds-back { padding: 8px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-void); } .ds-back button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-back button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Passport Chip
components.description: Fixed bottom-right counter that opens the passport sheet.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-void); color: var(--color-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Top bar links: muted, ink on hover, ink with a 2px accent underline when current.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; padding: 0 24px; height: 56px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-void); } .ds-nav a { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-muted); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 10px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=true] { color: var(--color-primary); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--color-accent); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Contact form control: no box, hairline underline that turns to ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-edge); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-field input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary); }

components.description: Hairline frame with registration crosshairs at each corner; holds the hero data page and project images.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; margin: 12px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-edge); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 70%, transparent); color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; pointer-events: none; color: var(--color-muted); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-position: left 0 top 8px, left 8px top 0, right 0 top 8px, right 8px top 0, left 0 bottom 8px, left 8px bottom 0, right 0 bottom 8px, right 8px bottom 0; background-size: 17px 1px, 1px 17px, 17px 1px, 1px 17px, 17px 1px, 1px 17px, 17px 1px, 1px 17px; } .ds-plate dt { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-plate dd { margin: 4px 0 0; }

narrative.overview:
By default the sky is the page. A fixed canvas of stars is a map you move across: drag it, zoom it, and six constellations, one per section, wait on a ring. Choosing one flies the camera there and opens that section in a panel beside it. A switch in the top bar turns the same content into Reading mode, the earlier Night Passport column: a passport read top to bottom, the data page first, each section a page of evidence with a stamp slot at its foot. At night the stars are light dots on deep blue ink; in daylight the same tokens become a printed star chart, dark dots on cool paper.

The reading layer stays quiet on purpose: hairlines instead of boxes, no cards, one amber accent, type doing the hierarchy. The sky does the atmosphere, the map does the wayfinding and the stamps do the delight, and none of them is required to read anything.
keyCharacteristics: Two modes over one set of sections: Star map (default) and Reading mode, remembered in localStorage; with no 2D canvas the page is always Reading.
Map: six constellations on a ring, a 720px drawer on the right from 1024px wide (a full sheet below), the Hero title block laid over the sky as the overview.
Reading: twelve-column grid, 1120px measure, title in the left four columns, evidence in the right eight.
Hairlines (1px, edge colour) carry structure. The .plate frame keeps crosshair corners as star-chart registration marks.
One accent (amber by night, burnt amber by day), always semantic.
Fraunces for the name and section titles, Geist for reading, JetBrains Mono for labels, coordinates, region names and the machine line.
Motion is CSS plus one canvas loop; every moving thing has a still state.

rules.name: The One Star Rule
rules.body: There is one accent. Never add a second hue; state differences are expressed with ink, muted, weight and underline. On the map "state" is the accent: the open region, a lit or traced figure.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Every text pair is checked by src/lib/contrast.test.ts, which reads src/index.css and fails under 4.5:1 in both schemes. Check a new pair there before using it.

rules.name: The Semantic Rule
rules.body: Components use bg-void, text-primary, text-muted, border-edge, bg-surface, text-accent, text-on-accent. No hex values and no dark: classes in components. Canvas code reads tokens through cssToken, because canvas ignores var().

rules.name: The Clerk's Hand Rule
rules.body: Mono is for data: labels, coordinates, counts, region names, the machine line. It is never used for headings or running text.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The serif speaks only the name and section titles. Everything under a title is Geist.

rules.name: The One Template Rule
rules.body: Every section uses the same SectionShell; a new section reuses it, and it renders as the Reading column or the panel column from the mode alone.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a hairline or a tint, never a shadow.

dos: Do use semantic colour utilities only, and add any new text pair to the contrast test.
Do reach for a hairline before a box, and a tint before a shadow.
Do reuse SectionShell for any new section and add its id to the map's regions so it gets a constellation and a label button.
Do keep the accent for links, the active item, the CV button, stamps, and lit or open constellations.
Do give anything that moves a still state and a motion-reduce or no-preference guard, and make any new sky effect droppable by the lite and still tiers.
Do keep everything readable and reachable without a stamp, the sky, sound, the passport, a pointer or the trace gesture.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, a card, or a drop shadow.
Don't write a hex value or a dark: class in a component.
Don't set body or label text in the serif, or headings in mono.
Don't make a stamp, the comet, the passport or a map gesture a gate on content.
Don't add an animation library; the sky is one canvas and one loop.
